frames.prompt:
USE CASE / OUTPUT
Create one production raster frame for garden-water / G1.
Output exact 627:627 aspect, one character, flat chroma-key green background, no text.

REFERENCE ROLES
Reference 1 is the active Miffy G1 pose-and-composition contract. Preserve its exact action phase, camera, framing, optical center, negative space, prop location/angle/endpoints, baseline, and padding.
Reference 2 is the identity contract. Replace Miffy with Malo, the approved bear; preserve the canonical silhouette, face, fixed colors, and wardrobe. Do not blend species or retain rabbit features.

SEMANTIC STATE
front-facing ready pose with upright can and zero droplets. This is one reviewed frame only, not a generic pose or animation sheet.

STYLE / FRAMING
Use simple flat children's-book color and restrained black linework. Keep the complete character and every required prop uncropped. Match the neighboring frame's apparent scale, line weight, colors, baseline, and composition. Use only flat chroma behind the subject.

INVARIANTS
Keep cream short-sleeve T-shirt and brick-red neckerchief unchanged. Keep the complete blue watering can and exactly the frame-specific water droplets shown by Reference 1.

AVOID
No Miffy or rabbit identity, pink dress, extra limbs, extra props, flowers, plants, scenery, shadows, text, logo, watermark, border, or droplets beyond the semantic frame.

normalization.method: reviewed raster resize and transparent-canvas translation only

checks: baseline, crop, apparent scale, and prop endpoints
transparent corners, fringe, and complete silhouette
